root_cause: release-sync-1928.js installed a MutationObserver on document.documentElement with childList:true,subtree:true. Its callback called sync(), and sync() assigned textContent to #headerRevision and #versionLabel. Those assignments themselves create child-list mutations, scheduling the same observer again. The observer could therefore continuously call itself until its 10-second disconnect timer, starving normal startup work.

current_repo_evidence.service_worker: Current 1.14.1 service worker injects release-sync-1928.js into navigation HTML.
current_repo_evidence.release_sync: Current release-sync-1928.js uses MutationObserver(()=>sync()) and sync() rewrites textContent.

correction: Removed the MutationObserver. Revision text is updated idempotently at DOMContentLoaded plus five bounded retries. No callback can trigger itself.
deployment: Overwrite only release-sync-1928.js in the repository root. Because the 1.14.1 service worker fetches JS with cache:'no-store', the corrected script should be used on the next reload/close-reopen without replacing the rest of the release.
